transcriber_notes: Measured on the embedded 6160x2832 chart raster (the PDF page crops it to the left half). Boundaries printed on the right axis and confirmed by bar/boundary lines in the plot (+-0.2 cm). Hardness from bar left edges against the grey gridlines (I/K/P/1F/4F/F at 707/967/1227/1487/1747/2007 px, 260 px per class; one third of a class read as +/-). Bar ends: 2010=F, 1750=4F, 1660=4F+, 1490=1F, 970=K, 1230=P. Grain type, grain size and water content columns are empty for every layer (hardness-only chart; the 120-118 boundary is drawn although both layers are F). No temperature line, no density column.
